_noteP: Ionian Fervor: at max stacks, basic attacks deal 10-67 (based on level) (+20% bonus AD) bonus magic damage on-hit. BIN 'OnHitBonus' = [a CalculationPart whose __type is the unresolved hash '{b22609db}', with fields '{91d404a5}'->'OnHitBaseDamage' and '{b2cd0eb0}'->'OnHitPerLevel' -- structurally a level-scaling term sourced by DataValue NAME rather than literal numbers, analogous to K'Sante's still-uncurated {ee18a47b} PercentHealthDamage part] + StatByCoefficient(mStat=2 AD, mStatFormula=2 = BONUS AD, coefficient 0.2). The level-scaling base term cannot be evaluated (FormulaInterpreter has no case for this hashed CalculationPart.Kind, and per this project's rule the interpreter is not extended to add one) -- genuinely blocked, same category as K'Sante's still-uncurated companion calc. Not curated; P carries no hits (attack-speed-only stacks are not damage and are also not modeled).
_noteQ: Bladesurge: dashes through the target dealing physical damage and applying on-hit effects. ChampionDamage = NamedDataValue(BaseDamage) + StatByCoefficient(mStat=2 TOTAL AD, no mStatFormula, coefficient 0.7) = wiki's 'Physical Damage: 5/25/45/65/85 (+70% AD)' exactly (BaseDamage DataValues rank1-5 = 5/25/45/65/85). The heal (HealAmount, a self-heal off total AD) and the separate 'bonus physical damage to minions' (MinionDamage) are not modeled -- combo target is a champion, and healing is not damage.
_noteW: Defiant Dance: channels then swipes, dealing physical damage that scales up the longer she charges (0-200% over 0.75s). MinDamageCalc (the GUARANTEED floor at zero charge time) = NamedDataValue(MinDamage) + StatByCoefficient(mStat=2 TOTAL AD, coefficient 0.4) + StatByCoefficient(no mStat field -> defaults to AP per FormulaInterpreter's 'part.Stat ?? 0', coefficient 0.5) = wiki's 'Minimum Physical Damage: 10/20/30/40/50 (+40% AD) (+50% AP)' exactly. MaxDamageCalc (30/60/90/120/150, +120%AD, +150%AP at full 0.75s charge) is marked 'tooltipOnly' in the BIN (not itself a live-evaluated calc) and additionally requires a full channel that is not guaranteed in a combo -- the guaranteed minimum is kept as the single conservative modeled hit, consistent with this project's 'narrowed, never closed' precedent for other charge/ramp-based abilities. FinalPhysicalDR/FinalMagicDR are the channel's damage-reduction shield, not damage dealt -- not applicable here.
_noteE: Flawless Duet: two blades converge, dealing magic damage and stunning. TotalDamage = NamedDataValue(BaseDamage) + StatByNamedDataValue(no mStat field -> AP default, mDataValue=APRatio=1.0) = wiki's 'Magic Damage: 70/110/150/190/230 (+100% AP)' exactly (BaseDamage DataValues rank1-5 = 70/110/150/190/230).
_noteR: Vanguard's Edge: launches a barrage that expands on the first enemy champion hit, dealing magic damage, then forms a perimeter for 2.5s. MissileDamage (the initial barrage hit) = NamedDataValue(BaseMissileDamage) + StatByNamedDataValue(no mStat field -> AP default, mDataValue=APRatio=0.7) = wiki's 'Magic Damage: 125/200/275 (+70% AP)' exactly (BaseMissileDamage DataValues rank1-3 = 125/200/275). ZoneDamage (an identical-value second proc if the target later crosses the perimeter blades) is a genuinely conditional/positional duplicate -- not guaranteed to land on the same combo target, so it is NOT added as a second count to avoid overstating realistic damage (P2); only the guaranteed initial-barrage hit (count 1) is modeled.
